verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never states the RX 9070 XT's actual VRAM capacity or memory bandwidth; the one VRAM figure mentioned ("up to 48GB") is a generic Radeon workstation-GPU claim, not this card's spec, and there is no claim or benchmark showing a 70B-class quantized model running on this GPU. Software support (ROCm, vLLM, llama.cpp) is documented but doesn't substitute for the missing capacity/bandwidth evidence needed to judge practicality for 70B inference.
